content.text: {"class": "PRODUCT_DEFECT", "reasoning": "The contract requires summing line items at full precision and rounding HALF_UP exactly once, but the debug logs show Money.of() rounding each line item individually (50.005 -> 50.00, 49.995 -> 49.99) before summation, yielding 99.99 instead of 100.00. This behavior was introduced by billing-service commit 4e8bb07 'refactor: centralise rounding in Money.of()' between the last green build #1841 and the failure, while the test file has been unchanged since March. The test's expectation of 100.00 is exactly what the contract mandates, so the application is genuinely wrong."}
